Package controller

  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    Features
    The Features interface defines all the user-interaction callbacks that the controller will handle, typically triggered by the View (GUI).
    ICalendarController
    An interface for handling calendar-related user input.
  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    CalendarController
    The CalendarController class implements the ICalendarController interface and serves as the controller in the Model-View-Controller (MVC) pattern for the calendar system.
    CalendarData
    Stores all the calendar model objects used for creating, editing events.
    Command
    An abstract class representing a command that can be executed within a calendar system.
    CopyEventCommand
    Command which provides operation to execute a copy operation of events from current calendar to a provided target calendar to a target calendar date/time.
    CreateCalendarCommand
    This class represents the create calendar command.
    CreateCommand
    This class extends the Command class.
    CreateEventCommand
    A command that creates a new event in the calendar system if event is conflicting with existing event it is not created regardless of the --autodecline argument value This class extends Command and implements the logic for adding events based on user input.
    EditCalendarCommand
    This class extends the Command class and represents the functionalities to edit a calendar.
    EditCommand
    This class is a generic class to represent two functionalities ie edit event and edit calendar.
    EditEventCommand
    A command that edits an existing event in the calendar system.
    ExportEventCommand
    A command that exports events from the calendar system.
    GraphicalController
    Represent a controller that accepts input from a graphical user interface and displays data on the graphical user interface.
    PrintEventCommand
    A command that prints event details to the console or another output medium.
    ShowStatusCommand
    A command that shows the current status of the calendar system.
    UseCalendarCommand
    The UseCalendarCommand class represents a command to switch to a specified calendar within a calendar management system.
